automatic_retries.finding: No application retry loop and NoRedirect exist. Default urllib opener may use environment proxy handlers; runtime and provider internal attempts are unverified.

broker_receipts.finding: Native typed answers do not satisfy frozen v2 judgment schema; broker live destination and metadata schema absent.

correlation.finding: No response headers or remote request correlation preserved by existing adapter.

egress.finding: Exact URL check is not network confinement. Default opener/proxy/DNS route is not a provider allowlist; current Q1 broker denies all real destinations.

fallback.finding: Request body carries model, no local fallback branch; jev-latest is a movable alias, not a fixed judge version.

fresh_context.finding: Body supplies complete state/questions; no conversation ID. Remote statelessness is not established; the fixed typed catalog has no meaningful prior-conversation marker test.

identity.finding: Strict response model parser establishes only presence of a model string. Nonempty alias passes; no returned request ID/attestation checked.

no_tools.finding: Inspected NativeJEVAdapter is a direct urllib POST/parser and has no local agent/tool dispatch code. This verifies local source behavior only; provider processing remains unverified.

packet_delivery.finding: Existing native questions differ from frozen v2 three-dimension judge-request/response contract. No demonstrated semantics-preserving bridge.

raw_bytes.finding: HTTPError bodies captured, but response headers omitted; read failure can discard partial data. Raw bytes may be redacted and truncated.

sealed_reservation.finding: Native adapter has one Python open call but no binding to Q1 broker dispatch journal.

timeout_cancel.finding: urllib timeout is not a guaranteed whole-exchange deadline. No remote cancellation or durable per-chunk publication in this adapter.

usage_billing.finding: Optional typed usage parser exists; billing unit and actual totals need account/provider evidence. No max_tokens request control established.

automatic_retries.finding: V5 local source has one Do, fresh HTTP/1 transport, no proxy/redirect/reuse, req.GetBody=nil, no retry loop. This verifies source-level client replay prevention, not remote execution counts or binary/runtime behavior.

broker_receipts.finding: Existing cARL live receipt and policy output differ from Q1 immutable receipts/judgment schema and mock framing. Do not replace broker raw evidence with parsed cARL results.

correlation.finding: Prepared/request/implementation hashes, status, sanitized headers and TLS captured. No injected broker correlation header; remote request ID existence/lookup unknown.

egress.finding: Fixed endpoint and Proxy=nil prevent URL/proxy selection in source, but no broker network confinement exists. Worker filter forbids running Go runtime/network anyway.

fallback.finding: No client fallback in inspected source, but native.Model accepts nonempty strings and default request uses moving jev-latest; returned model need not be version pinned.

fresh_context.finding: Prepared request fixes complete native state/questions; fresh HTTP transport per command. Fixed numeric question catalog cannot meaningfully test prior-conversation recall; shared server context needs provider assurance.

identity.finding: Receipt explicitly says local integrity, provider_authenticated=false; TLS certificate hashes identify endpoint, not served model.

no_tools.finding: Assessment live source posts prepared body; no LLM tools or arbitrary repo discovery. Preparation reads only explicit policy files; historical review CLI does require Git and is a separate incompatible path.

packet_delivery.finding: MatchedQuestions fixes claim support, uncertainty and authority Nouls, unlike v2 three-dimension labels/scores/rationales/quotes. Captured cARL policy is locally deterministic but not a v2 mapping.

raw_bytes.finding: Exact complete/error/partial/truncated HTTP bodies are represented, but credential/encoding bodies are withheld. CLI writes evidence only after EvaluateLive returns, so crash can lose received prefixes.

sealed_reservation.finding: CLI intent/new-directory exclusion is not Q1 campaign authority. Standalone evaluate-live can be invoked again with another output directory.

timeout_cancel.finding: context.WithTimeout and explicit failure classes exist in inspected source. Local timeout is not remote cancellation; whole-call reads remain volatile until return.

usage_billing.finding: Typed optional usage accepted, but live billing and internal attempts unknown. No request token ceiling established.
